title: Calgary to the Rocky Mountains Private Day Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Embark on a captivating journey from Calgary into the heart of Kananaskis Country. The Kananaskis Discovery Tour is a perfect, quick, and immersive introduction to the stunning Canadian Rockies. Ideal for conference attendees or travelers with limited time, this tour provides a rich mountain experience, all within a convenient 4-6 hour timeframe.

Craft your own mountain escape with our private and customizable tour. Choose between beginner or intermediate hikes and explore Kananaskis' natural beauty at your own pace. Our certified hiking guide will tailor the day to match your preferences, ensuring an unforgettable adventure.

Photography Opportunities: Capture stunning landscapes and wildlife with help from our guides. Our guides will also take footage of your day.

Food & Beverage: Enjoy a locally made meal, along with bottomless refreshments and snacks.

Round-Trip Comfort: Start and end your journey in Calgary, making it a convenient option for those with limited time.
